seed_policy.rationale: Reuse only already-consumed historical development seeds for engine/public-agent screening; no fresh confirmation, robustness, holdout, or promotion seed is opened.

authority.scope: local read-only agent evaluation and evidence generation

definitions.failure: A row is invalid if runner error is non-null, either terminal status is not DONE, or either reward is null.
definitions.hidden_abnormal_status: The hardened runner scans all env.steps and records the first status outside ACTIVE/INACTIVE/DONE, even if the terminal interpreter later reports DONE.
definitions.score: Win=1, tie=0.5, loss=0, calculated only for valid rows.
definitions.margin: candidate final reward minus opponent final reward.
definitions.runtime: Wall-clock seconds for the whole local game, not isolated per-agent compute.

limitations: All seeds are consumed development-screen seeds and are promotion-ineligible.
The 1.32.2/1.32.6 comparison has only 20 paired logical cells.
Local game wall time includes engine and both agents.
Equal result vectors do not prove source equivalence or action-trace equivalence.
